traits.name: Self-Loathing
traits.text: (emotion, mental); A mitflit's self-loathing makes it easy to influence. It takes a –4 penalty to its Will DC against checks to Coerce, Demoralize, Make an Impression, and Request.

traits.name: Vermin Empathy
traits.text: Mitflits can use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request things of arthropods (insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals). Most arthropods have a starting attitude of indifferent to mitflits.

traits.name: Vengeful Anger
traits.text: (emotion, mental); As long as it isn't frightened, a mitflit gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls against a creature that has previously damaged or tormented it.
